messages.text: Looked up for Sarah: Magic Miner 40T, $799, Batch 6 ships Nov 21, 2026 — best value per TH we sell; power at 16¢ runs about what the page states.
Looked up for Sarah: 40T has an Eco mode: 30 TH/s at 450W, ~50 dB — desk-friendly. 40 TH/s/650W is standard; at 16¢ that's about $75 a month.

Hey, I'm Sarah! At about sixteen cents the Magic Miner 40T costs around $75 a month to run. It's $799, and it draws for a full block every ten minutes. Would it run on a desk, or somewhere out of the way? Tap an answer, or the mic and tell me.
Looked up for Sarah: 650W means real heat, like a space heater. Eco mode drops it to 450W and 30 TH/s, about $52 a month at 16¢, quieter at ~50 dB.
At your rate that's about seventy-five dollars a month in power. Fair warning: at six fifty watts it throws real heat. Is the office warm already?

Yes, it puts out about as much heat as a small space heater. On a desk, Eco mode runs it at thirty terahash on four-fifty watts, about fifty decibels, and around fifty-two dollars a month at your rate. Eco mode or full power? (The call ended. 2 shopper turn(s). Reply NOTHING.)
